scope: R5 encrypted device draft verification and existing browser regression

tests.name: R5 offline ciphertext survives real browser restart and reauthentication, then syncs without restoring confirmation
R5 lost business response resolves committed outcome after browser restart without another candidate
R5 other account cannot decrypt or display this profile unsynchronized input
R5 old key restores and reencrypts under current key; revoked version never restores
R5 tampered ciphertext and expired server draft are refused, not erased or replayed
R5 IndexedDB failure is not reported as durable and blocks business submission
R5 concurrent tab candidates remain distinct without overwriting typed input
R5 not-recorded intent waits for confirmation and reuses original operation instead of a new key
R5 durable draft-wide tombstone refuses a delayed crypto write from another tab
R5 uncertain draft mutation is replayed before syncing the newer local input
R5 opener-cloned sessionStorage gets a separate tab identity and preserves both inputs
R5 discard creates a durable marker before any local slot and rejects its delayed first write
R5 inactive form resolves a committed pending receipt from the list without decrypting or replaying it

secrets_policy: No trace, video, storageState, network dump or failure screenshot. Diagnostics redact credentials and URLs.
